news.title: El Nino could add to US inflation pressures in 2027, San Francisco Fed paper warns
news.summary: A San Francisco Fed study warns the current strong El Niño could drive US inflation up by 1 percentage point in 2027, despite temporarily boosting jobs. With inflation already above the 2% target, the climate shock adds further pressure on the Fed to raise interest rates.

news.title: Why traders are moving away from equity F&O to commodities? Nithin Kamath explains
news.summary: Commodity derivatives traders in India surged nearly 62% to 21 lakh in FY26, while equity F&O participants fell 20% to 85 lakh. Zerodha's Nithin Kamath cited commodity volatility, options popularity and extended MCX trading hours.
